# Etsy MCP

Use this command to work with the official Etsy Dev MCP server.

## Purpose
Use the Etsy MCP server to inspect Etsy Open API v3 endpoints, schema objects, OAuth flow, and guide material.

## Prompt
Use the Etsy MCP server to help with Etsy API discovery, OAuth setup, listing and order workflows, and shop integration planning. Start by checking the available Etsy API overview and then narrow to the exact endpoint or schema needed.

## Typical requests
- Find listings-related endpoints and required scopes
- Explain how to authenticate an Etsy seller app
- Inspect the schema for `ShopReceipt` or `ShopListing`
- Design a sales or inventory integration with Etsy
- Review OAuth refresh and access-token handling
